_comment: Maps each spec file (as it appears in test-results.json `file` fields — testDir-relative, forward slashes) to the business capability it proves. Used by scripts/business-digest.js to build the stakeholder 'what's working / what's broken' section of the nightly Slack alerts. Keep names short, plain-English, and capability-level (several specs may share one capability). A spec missing from this map still shows up in the digest, labelled '(unmapped)' — add it here when that happens.
